hooks.text: For eight hundred years, foreign armies failed to breach Rome.
The Eternal City lay defended while its emperor fled north.
Rome was invincible until the Goths arrived at the gate.

title: Why Did Rome Fall for the First Time in 800 Years? 🏛️
description: Witness the final hours before the Visigoths breached the Salarian Gate in 410 AD.

beats.text: For eight hundred years, foreign armies failed to breach Rome.
beats.visual: engraving of the Aurelian Walls of Rome, 19th century

beats.text: Emperor [Honorius](/hˈOnˈɔɹˈiˌʌs/) ruled safely from the distant city of Ravenna.
beats.visual: coin portrait of Flavius Honorius, 5th century

beats.text: Outside the walls, King Alaric tightened a starving blockade.
beats.visual: engraving of King Alaric I, 19th century

beats.text: On August twenty-fourth, the Visigoths poured through the Salarian Gate.
beats.visual: painting of the Roman Forum ruins, 19th century

beats.text: For three days, the conquerors pillaged the ancient capital.
beats.visual: engraving of the Sack of Rome by the Visigoths, 19th century

beats.text: Saint Jerome wrote that the world itself was taken.
beats.visual: painting of Saint Jerome in his study, 15th century
queries: Saint Jerome in his Study painting

card.big: The city which had taken the whole world was itself taken.

beats.text: Foreign armies had finally breached Rome after eight hundred years.
beats.visual: map of the Western Roman Empire and Visigothic movements, 5th century
